artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 9-hour plan: promote the closure-indexed periodicity prototype to the seventeenth wired probe, then land an eighteenth probe (eleven pinned theorems, compiled sorry-bodied at plan time) that defines the LOCAL coherence relation on the coprime-cycle fixture and shows the countdown profile separates gate 6's pair with no parameter; adequacy and obligations (b)-(d) stay open and are named as non-goals.

memory_candidates.content: Closure-indexed evidence probes over PlusFormula: a closure type must be built as a Finset.filter of plusSubformulaClosure with the subtype proof Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (Finset.filter_subset _ _); `decide` on Finset.powerset membership over an 18-element closure hits maxRecDepth. `decide` DOES close concrete per-type coherence facts (Hintikka conditions plus strict-until links evaluated over the closure) in under a second, and the box/snce/stab-free fragment check over the closure. Anything quantifying over all closure types (2^18 per object state) must be proved by hand through an unfolding lemma (`simp [coh, locCoh, untlLink, Bool.and_eq_true, and_assoc]`) and per-formula instantiation with membership by `decide`. Fintype/DecidableEq for Q x {T // T ∈ cl.powerset} resolve by inferInstance.
